sections.heading: What Our Before & After Rebuild Gallery Shows

blocks.html: Every engine rebuild we complete is documented from arrival through strip-down, machining, assembly, and final installation. This gallery shows real Land Rover engines we've rebuilt — from the [TDV6/SDV6](/landrover-tdv6-sdv6-engine) and [Ingenium AJ200D](/landrover-aj200d-engine) to the [AJ133 V8](/landrover-aj133-engine) and [Td5](/landrover-td5-engine).
What you won't see here: stock photography, generic engine shots, or photos taken anywhere other than our workshop. These are genuine rebuilds on real Land Rover models.

sections.heading: Land Rover Models & Engines We Rebuild
Our Engine Rebuild Process — Documented at Every Stage

steps.title: Arrival & Assessment
steps.body: Vehicle arrives at our workshop. Engine is inspected, compression tested, and any fault codes logged.

steps.title: Strip-Down & Inspection
steps.body: Engine removed, stripped to bare block. Each component inspected and measured for wear.

steps.title: Machining
steps.body: Cylinder boring, crankshaft grinding, head resurfacing, and block decking as required.

steps.title: Parts Replacement
steps.body: New bearings, piston rings, timing chain, tensioners, gaskets, and seals fitted.

steps.title: Reassembly
steps.body: Engine rebuilt to factory specification with calibrated torque settings.

steps.title: Installation & Testing
steps.body: Engine fitted into vehicle. Road-test and final quality checks completed.

items: **Fixed-price quote** — no hidden costs once the engine is stripped

sections.heading: How It Works — From Quote to Collection

steps.body: Send your registration or call us — we'll identify your engine family and confirm if a rebuild is the right option.
We arrange nationwide recovery to bring your vehicle to our Essex workshop.
We strip the engine, inspect every component, and provide a fixed-price quote for the rebuild.
We machine, rebuild, install, and road-test your engine — typically 3-5 working days.
Collect your Land Rover or we can arrange delivery back to you.

items.q: Are these photos from real Land Rover rebuild jobs?
items.a: Yes — these are genuine rebuilds performed at our workshop. Some images are staged on real premises photos pending our full completed-job photography library being compiled, but every rebuild shown is real work carried out by our team.

items.q: Which Land Rover models do you rebuild?
items.a: We rebuild all Land Rover models: [Defender](/defender-engines), [Discovery](/discovery-engines), [Discovery Sport](/discovery-sport-engines), [Freelander](/freelander-engines), [Range Rover](/landrover-range-rover-tdv6-engines), [Range Rover Sport](/range-rover-sport-engines), [Range Rover Velar](/range-rover-velar-engines), and [Range Rover Evoque](/range-rover-evoque-engines). Every engine family from the [Td5](/landrover-td5-engine) and [300Tdi](/landrover-300tdi-engine) to the [Ingenium AJ200D](/landrover-aj200d-engine) and [AJ133 V8](/landrover-aj133-engine).

items.q: How long does a Land Rover engine rebuild take?
items.a: Most rebuilds are completed in 3-5 working days from arrival at our workshop.

items.q: Do you provide a warranty on rebuilt engines?
items.a: Yes — every rebuild includes a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty on parts and labour. [Read our warranty terms →](/warranty)
Yes — we can recover your Land Rover from anywhere in the UK. Recovery is charged separately from the rebuild. [Learn more about our recovery service →](/landrover-engine-recovery)
